# Criaphore

## Introduction

Criaphore is SaaS company creating applications in service of people powered by AI

## Applications

[Orbora](https://criaphore.com/orbora/): Generative audio wellness agentic app developed by Criaphore
[Diagnosly](https://criaphore.com/diagnosly/): Health application for medical diagnosis powered by AI developed by Criaphore
